title: Schedule of Checked Baggage Allowances, Bag Charges and Pet Carriage — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
The number of checked bags included in the fare for each traveller and whether a full-size cabin bag is included in the fare are fixed by the fare brand held; bags taken beyond the included allowance, bags above the weight allowance, bags above the size allowance and a pet carried in the cabin are charged at the rates stated for that brand. Both tables below apply to the seven brands of Air Ticket Fare Brands.

Allowance table.

| Fare brand | Checked bags included for each traveller | Full-size cabin bag included |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0 | not included |
| Economy Saver | 0 | included |
| Economy Classic | 1 | included |
| Economy Flex | 1 | included |
| Premium Economy Select | 2 | included |
| Business Saver | 2 | included |
| Business Flex | 3 | included |

Charges table.

| Fare brand | First checked bag where not included, USD | Second checked bag where not included, USD | Each bag above the weight allowance, USD | Each bag above the size allowance, USD | Each pet carried in the cabin, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 40.00 | 55.00 | 125.00 | 200.00 | 150.00 |
| Economy Saver | 35.00 | 50.00 | 115.00 | 185.00 | 150.00 |
| Economy Classic | 35.00 | 45.00 | 100.00 | 175.00 | 125.00 |
| Economy Flex | 30.00 | 45.00 | 100.00 | 175.00 | 125.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | 30.00 | 45.00 | 90.00 | 150.00 | 125.00 |
| Business Saver | 30.00 | 40.00 | 75.00 | 125.00 | 100.00 |
| Business Flex | 30.00 | 40.00 | 75.00 | 125.00 | 100.00 |

Annotations to the tables.

1. The first and second bag lines are charged where the bag is not included in the fare. Under Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver, which include 0 checked bags, both lines fall to be charged, at 40.00 and 55.00 under the first brand and 35.00 and 50.00 under the second. Under Economy Classic and Economy Flex, which include 1 checked bag, the second bag line of 45.00 falls to be charged. Under Premium Economy Select and Business Saver, which include 2, and under Business Flex, which includes 3, neither of those two lines falls to be charged on bags within the included allowance.

2. The weight line is charged for each checked bag above the weight allowance and the size line for each checked bag above the size allowance: 125.00 and 200.00 under Basic Economy Lite, 115.00 and 185.00 under Economy Saver, 100.00 and 175.00 under Economy Classic and Economy Flex alike, 90.00 and 150.00 under Premium Economy Select, and 75.00 and 125.00 under Business Saver and Business Flex alike.

3. A full-size cabin bag is included in the fare under every brand except Basic Economy Lite.

4. The pet in cabin line is charged for each pet: 150.00 under Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver, 125.00 under Economy Classic, Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select, and 100.00 under Business Saver and Business Flex.
